import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item


def test_issue_partial_remove_one():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 3 - 1 = 2


def test_issue_partial_remove_two():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=2)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 1  # 3 - 2 = 1


def test_issue_exact_qty_removes_line():
    """Removing the line when it reaches zero."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=3)
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 3 - 3 = 0, line removed


def test_issue_no_qty_removes_whole_line():
    """With no qty, remove the whole line (current behavior)."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG")
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # whole line of 3 removed


def test_issue_remove_more_than_present_raises():
    """Removing more units than are in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=4)  # 4 > 3, just above boundary


def test_issue_remove_missing_sku_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG")


def test_issue_remove_missing_sku_with_qty_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="CUP", name="Cup", price_cents=500, qty=1))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)


def test_issue_partial_remove_updates_subtotal():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2400  # (3 - 1) * 1200 = 2400


def test_contract_add_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=2))
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 3  # 1 + 2 = 3
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 4500  # 1500 * 3 = 4500


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounded_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 19  # floor(199 * 10 / 100) = floor(19.9) = 19


def test_contract_shipping_free_at_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 so free


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 16  # 199 * 8 / 100 = 15.92 rounds to 16


def test_contract_total_formula():
    """Total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 3839  # 3000 + 599 + 240 = 3839; tax 3000*8/100=240
